## Details

<a id="font"></a>
### [`font`](../../../../src/graphics/font.asm#L6) `$E800-$E937`

*data*

Font of the text printer, 8 bytes for each glyph (39 glyphs): space, A-Z, 0-9, "(" and ")". $938d gives the glyph address $e800+8n. $92eb makes multicolour cells from each glyph. The hit-record bug at $87e5 reads $e81a-$e81d, $e822-$e825 and $e82e-$e831 as hit records.

- **Read by:** [`check_attack_hit`](../combat/hits.md#check_attack_hit), [`apply_hit_damage`](../combat/hits.md#apply_hit_damage), [`spawn_hit_sprite`](../combat/hits.md#spawn_hit_sprite)
- **Referred to by:** [`get_glyph_ptr`](../text/print_text.md#get_glyph_ptr)
